# GLSL Shaders

Three hosts: `glslTOP`/`glslmultiTOP` (pixels, or compute over an image), `glslMAT` (vertex + pixel over geometry), `glslPOP` (compute over points; the POP side lives in `/pop-networks`). Every function and parameter below compiled live on TD 2025.33230 (probed 2026-09-25). Anything you add beyond them: check the parameter with `describe_op_type` and the function with the docked info DAT before trusting it.

## The docked-DAT contract

- Creating a `glslTOP`/`glslmultiTOP` docks `<name>_pixel`, `<name>_compute`, `<name>_info`, with `pixeldat`/`computedat` already pointing at them. A `glslMAT` docks `<name>_vertex`, `<name>_pixel`, `<name>_info` (`vdat`/`pdat`). A `glslPOP` docks `<name>_compute` and `<name>_info`.
- Name the operator at creation (`glsl_<purpose>`): dock names and the `*dat` references are snapshots taken then and do not follow a later rename.
- Write the shader INTO the docked DAT (`set_dat_content` / `edit_dat_content`). Delete the dock you do not use (`_compute` for a pixel shader) so it does not ship as dead weight. One exception: several GLSL ops running identical code point at ONE shared DAT and differ by uniforms (`tdxn-economy.md`).
- `create_op` hugs the docks under the host; an `execute_python` build must place them itself (`/create-operator`).
- Read compile results from `<name>_info`: `op.errors()` says only "Compile failed". `get_op_errors` returns them as `shaderErrors`, and every DAT write to a shader rides back `_effects.new_shader_errors`. Fix those before building further.

## What TD gives you (never redeclare, never paste an alternative)

- No `#version` line: TD injects one, and writing your own fails with "'#version' : must occur first in shader". `texture()`, never `texture2D()` ("function not supported in this version; use texture() instead").
- Inputs: `sTD2DInputs[i]`, `sTD3DInputs[i]`, `sTD2DArrayInputs[i]`, `sTDCubeInputs[i]`, indexed per TYPE, not per connector. `TD_NUM_2D_INPUTS` (and the 3D/array/cube twins) bound a loop and guard a dynamic index. `uTD2DInfos[i].res` and `uTDOutputInfo.res` are `(1/w, 1/h, w, h)`. `vUV.st` is the 0-1 texture coordinate when there is no custom vertex shader. `uTDPass` is the multi-pass index, `uTDCurrentDepth` the 3D slice.
- Lookups: `sTDNoiseMap` (256x256 random), `sTDSineLookup`.
- Functions: `TDOutputSwizzle(vec4)` on EVERY color you write out (channel order is wrong without it), `TDDither`, `TDPerlinNoise(vec2|vec3|vec4)` and `TDSimplexNoise(vec2|vec3|vec4)` (both in -1..1, available in TOP, MAT and glslPOP shaders on this build), `TDHSVToRGB`, `TDRGBToHSV`, `TDRotateOnAxis(rad, axis)`, `TDRotateX/Y/Z(rad)`.
- Compute in a `glslTOP` (`mode=compute`): declare `layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;`, write with `TDImageStoreOutput(0, ivec3(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy, 0), TDOutputSwizzle(color))`, read the output back with `TDImageLoadOutput(0, ivec3(...))`.
- `glslTOP` has exactly 3 input connectors. `glslmultiTOP` takes more and adds POP buffer reads (`buffer0pop`, `buffer0attr`, `buffer0name` -> `TDBuffer_<Name>(idx)` in the shader). Reach for `glslmultiTOP` whenever you need a fourth input or a POP attribute.

## Uniforms

- Vectors page: `vec0name` + `vec0valuex/y/z/w`, a sequence (grow it with `op.seq.vec.numBlocks = N`). On a TOP or MAT the SHADER declares the uniform and TD infers the type from the declaration (`uniform vec4 uParams;`); there is no `vec0type` here, and an undeclared name silently reads nothing. Pack four values per vec; the values take expressions (`absTime.seconds * parent.Fx.par.Speed`).
- Colors page: `color0name` + `color0rgbr/g/b` + `color0alpha` -> `uniform vec4 uTint;` with a colour swatch in the dialog. Use it for colours instead of a raw vec.
- Constants page: `const0name`/`const0value` are baked in at compile time, so every change RECOMPILES the shader. Runtime values belong on Vectors; constants only for true compile-time switches.
- `glslPOP` inverts one rule: its uniforms are AUTO-DECLARED from the Vectors page (`uniform highp float uSpeed;` by default). Declaring them again is a "Redeclaration" error, and the type comes from `vec0type` (`float`, `vec2`..`vec4`, `int`, `uint`, ...). Samplers, Arrays, Matrices and Buffers pages follow the same shape on every host.

## Pixel shader minimum

```glsl
uniform vec4 uParams;           // Vectors page: vec0name = uParams
layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragColor;
void main() {
    vec4 c = texture(sTD2DInputs[0], vUV.st);
    fragColor = TDOutputSwizzle(c * uParams.x);
}
```

Output format and resolution are parameters, not shader code: `format` (`rgba8fixed` clamps to 0-1 -- data, feedback and HDR need `rgba16float` or `rgba32float`), `outputresolution` (`useinput`, `custom` with `resolutionw`/`resolutionh`, `fit`, ...). There is no `resolution` parameter. `premultrgbbyalpha` defaults ON and multiplies RGB by your alpha -- turn it off on an op whose alpha carries data. Multiple render targets: `numcolorbufs`, declare `layout(location = 1) out vec4 fragField;`, and pull buffer N with a Render Select TOP (set its `format` to float).

## glslMAT

One combined DAT with `#ifdef TD_VERTEX_SHADER` / `#ifdef TD_PIXEL_SHADER` guards, set as BOTH `vdat` and `pdat`; keep `_info`.

- Vertex: `TDDeform(TDPos())` gives the world position (never raw `TDPos()` -- instancing and deformers ride on TDDeform), `TDDeformNorm(TDNormal())` the world normal, `TDWorldToProj(worldPos)` is `gl_Position`, `TDCameraIndex()` goes out as a `flat int` varying, `TDPointColor()` / `TDInstanceColor(c)` carry point and instance colour.
- Pixel: `TDCheckDiscard()` first; `uTDMats[cam].camInverse[3].xyz` is the camera position; loop `TD_NUM_LIGHTS` with `TDLightingPBR(i, diffuseColor, specularColor, worldPos, normal, shadowStrength, shadowColor, viewDir, roughness)` (a `TDPBRResult` with `.diffuse`/`.specular`) and `TD_NUM_ENV_LIGHTS` with `TDEnvLightingPBR(inout diffuse, inout specular, i, diffuseColor, specularColor, normal, viewDir, roughness, ambientOcclusion)`; `TDFog(color, worldPos, cam)`; then `TDOutputSwizzle(TDDither(color))` into `oFragColor[0]`, declared `layout(location = 0) out vec4 oFragColor[TD_NUM_COLOR_BUFFERS];`.
- Transparency needs `blending` ON and honest `srcblend`/`destblend` (`one`, `zero`, `sa`, `omsa`, ...) with the alpha pair `srcblenda`/`destblenda`; `cullface=neither` shows both faces of filled POP geometry.
- Extending a PBR look: start from a `pbrMAT` and pulse `outputshader` -- TD writes its own vertex and pixel code into a new glslMAT for you to edit.

## Feedback and multi-pass

- Feedback: Constant TOP (clear) -> Feedback TOP -> glsl -> Null TOP; the Feedback TOP's `top` names the null that closes the loop, `resetpulse` resets it. Close the loop BEFORE compiling shaders that depend on the fed-back texture. Bound every loop per `performance.md`: fixed resolution inside it, decay below 1, reset wired, bypassed while wiring.
- One feedback is one iteration per frame. Iterative solvers use `npasses` on the GLSL op instead: pass N+1 sees pass N on input 0, `uTDPass` tells you which.
- 3D output: `type=texture3d`, `depth=custom`, `customdepth=N`; the shader runs once per slice with `uTDCurrentDepth`. `constantTOP` and `noiseTOP` have no `customdepth`, so seed a volume from a small `glslTOP`, not from them.

## Discipline

- A built-in operator beats a shader when one exists (Noise, Ramp, Lookup, Composite, Level TOPs; Math and Lookup CHOPs). GLSL is for what they cannot express: advection, solvers, custom lighting, per-point compute.
- Bound every loop with a constant and guard dynamic sampler or array indexes with `TD_NUM_*`: an out-of-bounds index can take TD down (`/td-api-reference`, Heavy-Build Safety).
- `centroid` is a reserved word in GLSL 4.60. `me.time.step` does not exist: delta time is `absTime.stepSeconds` (or `1.0 / me.time.rate`).
- Externalize shader DATs with `externalize_op` (tag `glsl`) so they diff in git; edit the file, TD recompiles.
- Verify by looking: `capture_top` the output (a `Quality: FAIL` is a black or flat frame) and read `<name>_info` after every edit. A shader that compiles and renders TD's fallback pattern still reads as an error in the info DAT.

Topics cross-checked against Derivative's TDMCPSkills `td-glsl-shaders` with permission; every claim above was recompiled live on 2025.33230 before it was written down.
